items.summary: The CMG World Robot Competition Series Tournament, organized by China Media Group, began on May 25 in Hangzhou and was broadcast live, with Unitree G1 robots competing in what the report describes as the world's first humanoid robot combat tournament.

items.summary: NPR reports that Ukraine destroyed more than 40 military aircraft in a drone attack deep inside Russia, disclosed the same day Zelenskyy said Kyiv would send a delegation to Istanbul for a new round of direct peace talks on Monday.

items.title: Ukraine destroys more than 40 military aircraft in drone attack deep in Russia

items.summary: NPR reports that Ukraine destroyed more than 40 military aircraft in a drone attack deep inside Russia, disclosed the same day Zelenskyy said Kyiv would send a delegation to Istanbul for a new round of direct peace talks on Monday.

items.title: A new class of materials that can passively harvest water from air
items.title_zh: 一类可从空气中被动收集水分的新型材料
items.summary: Researchers at Penn Engineering report discovering nanostructured materials that can passively harvest water from the air without energy input, enabling water-harvesting systems for arid regions.

items.title: Hacker News now runs on top of Common Lisp
items.title_zh: Hacker News 现在运行在 Common Lisp 之上
items.summary: A blog post notes that Hacker News, written in Paul Graham's Arc dialect, now runs on SBCL rather than Racket, reportedly since at least September 2024, with performance given as the reason.

items.title: Just make it scale: An Aurora DSQL story
items.title_zh: 只管让它扩展：Aurora DSQL 的故事
items.summary: AWS engineers Niko Matsakis and Marc Bowes describe building Aurora DSQL, including scaling writes without two-phase commit, working through garbage collection challenges and using Rust for both the data and control planes.

items.title: The Myth of Developer Obsolescence
items.title_zh: 开发者过时论的神话
items.summary: The article argues that AI is transforming software developers rather than replacing them, comparing the shift to how no-code tools and cloud computing created new specialties, and says designing coherent systems matters more than writing code.

items.title: Getting a Cease and Desist from Waffle House
items.title_zh: 收到 Waffle House 的停止侵权通知函
items.summary: The author reverse-engineered Waffle House's website to build a live version of the unofficial Waffle House Index and later received a cease-and-desist notice over it.

items.title: EasyTier – P2P mesh VPN written in Rust using Tokio
items.title_zh: EasyTier：用 Rust 与 Tokio 编写的 P2P 网状 VPN
items.summary: EasyTier is a decentralized SD-WAN solution for intranet penetration that is implemented in Rust using the Tokio framework, according to its website.

items.title: Oxfordshire clock still keeping village on time after 500 years
items.title_zh: 牛津郡古钟 500 年后仍为村庄报时
items.summary: A clock in Oxfordshire is believed to be one of the oldest in Britain still in its original location, and it is still keeping the village on time after 500 years.

items.title: Ask HN: What is the best LLM for consumer grade hardware?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：消费级硬件上跑哪个大模型最合适？
items.summary: A Hacker News user with a 16GB RTX 5060 Ti asks the community to recommend an LLM that can hold basic conversations at close to real-time speed on consumer hardware.

items.title: The Darwin Gödel Machine: AI that improves itself by rewriting its own code
items.title_zh: 达尔文·哥德尔机：通过改写自身代码实现自我改进的 AI
items.summary: A project introduces the Darwin Gödel Machine, an AI system described as improving itself by rewriting its own code.

items.title: Consider Knitting
items.title_zh: 不妨试试编织
items.summary: A programmer recalls growing up when knitting was strongly coded as female, says he never considered taking it up, and notes that he did learn cross-stitch as a child.

items.title: Sid Meier's Pirates – In-depth (2017)
items.title_zh: 《席德·梅尔的海盗》深度回顾（2017）
items.summary: A detailed, picture-heavy retrospective review of Sid Meier's Pirates! as released on the Amiga.

items.title: Google AI Edge – On-device cross-platform AI deployment
items.title_zh: Google AI Edge：跨平台端侧 AI 部署
items.summary: Google AI Edge lets developers deploy machine learning and generative AI models directly across mobile, web and embedded applications, aiming for lower latency, offline functionality and stronger data privacy.

items.title: Why DeepSeek is cheap at scale but expensive to run locally
items.title_zh: 为什么 DeepSeek 大规模部署便宜、本地运行却昂贵
items.summary: The post examines why DeepSeek-V3 is said to be fast and cheap to serve at scale but too slow and expensive to run locally, and why some AI models respond slowly at first.

items.title: Ask HN: Anyone struggling to get value out of coding LLMs?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：你是否也难以从编程大模型中获得实际价值？
items.summary: An Ask HN poster says LLMs save time on one-off snippets, debugging help and unfamiliar-language tasks, but have almost never helped with the core code they work on, after trying Cursor, Google's Jules and OpenAI Codex with o4.

items.title: Nova: A JavaScript and WebAssembly engine written in Rust
items.title_zh: Nova：用 Rust 编写的 JavaScript 与 WebAssembly 引擎
items.summary: Nova is a JavaScript and WebAssembly engine implemented in Rust and built around data-oriented design principles.

items.title: Unitree G1 Robots battle in world’s first humanoid robot combat tournament
items.title_zh: Unitree G1 机器人参加全球首场人形机器人格斗赛
items.summary: The CMG World Robot Competition Series Tournament, organized by China Media Group, began on May 25 in Hangzhou and was broadcast live, with Unitree G1 robots competing in what the report describes as the world's first humanoid robot combat tournament.

items.title: US reportedly orders top EDA firms to halt services to China
items.title_zh: 美国据报道要求顶尖 EDA 厂商停止对华服务
items.summary: The U.S. Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security has reportedly sent notices to Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA, the three leading EDA suppliers, as part of an order to halt services to China.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: Former NBA star Meta World Peace talks basketball, business, and China at Global Investment Summit
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025：前 NBA 球星 Meta World Peace 在全球投资峰会谈篮球、商业与中国
items.summary: Metta World Peace, formerly known as Ron Artest, shared insights on his journey from NBA champion to entrepreneur during a panel at the BEYOND Expo Global Investment Summit.

items.title: China’s GAC sells five EV models in Brazil with view to local production
items.title_zh: 中国广汽在巴西销售五款电动车型，并着眼本地生产
items.summary: Chinese automaker GAC announced on May 23 that it is selling electric vehicles in Brazil, offering five models with a view to local production.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: Alibaba Chairman Joe Tsai admits to Chinese tech giant’s “setbacks,” sees AI as key to global growth
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025：阿里巴巴主席蔡崇信承认公司遭遇“挫折”，视 AI 为全球增长关键
items.summary: Alibaba Chairman Joe Tsai told the closing audience at BEYOND Expo 2025 that the company has learned to be resilient and to always think about living another day; the report says he acknowledged setbacks and sees AI as key to global growth.

items.title: Great Wall Motor’s CEO goes public criticizing BYD over unfair competition
items.title_zh: 长城汽车 CEO 公开批评比亚迪不正当竞争
items.summary: Chinese authorities have set up a joint investigative group and promised a fair judgment on Great Wall Motor's allegation that BYD engaged in unfair competition, a claim the GWM CEO has publicly criticized BYD over.

items.title: TSMC to open Munich Design Centre in Q3 to support advanced chip design for Europe
items.title_zh: 台积电将于第三季度在慕尼黑开设设计中心，支持欧洲先进芯片设计
items.summary: At TSMC's 2025 Europe Technology Symposium, ESMC general manager Paul de Bot announced that TSMC will open a Munich design centre in the third quarter to support advanced chip design for Europe.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: NIP Group CEO Mario Ho sees a shift from esports’ “winter” to an era of transformation
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025：NIP Group CEO 何猷君称电竞正从“寒冬”走向转型
items.summary: At BEYOND Expo 2025 in Macao on May 24, NIP Group CEO Mario Ho shared his views on the esports industry shifting from a 'winter' into an era of transformation.

items.title: BEYOND Expo 2025: China’s Xbot Park is redefining tech incubation and leaving Western models behind, says founder
items.title_zh: BEYOND Expo 2025：创始人称 Xbot Park 正重新定义科技孵化，超越西方模式
items.summary: Xbot Park, an innovation hub developed by robotics expert Li Zexiang, is presented as a window into China's evolving approach to deep-tech incubation, with its founder arguing it leaves Western models behind.

items.title: AMD to roll out AI chip customized for China this July
items.title_zh: AMD 将于今年 7 月推出面向中国市场的定制 AI 芯片
items.summary: AMD is preparing to release an AI chip designed to comply with China-market requirements, aiming to expand its influence there, with the launch expected in July, according to TechNode.

items.title: Devi766/Diodos-Android
items.title_zh: Devi766/Diodos-Android
items.summary: Diodos is described in its GitHub listing as elegant network tools, packaged as an Android project.

items.title: lingdojo/kana-dojo
items.title_zh: lingdojo/kana-dojo
items.summary: kana-dojo is a minimalist platform for learning Japanese inspired by Duolingo and Monkeytype, built with Next.js, sponsored by Vercel and pitched at beginners with many good first issues.

items.title: Alibaba-NLP/VRAG
items.title_zh: Alibaba-NLP/VRAG：通义实验室的多模态 RAG 框架
items.summary: Tongyi Lab at Alibaba Group built VRAG, a framework that combines multimodal inputs with retrieval-augmented generation.

items.title: sohzm/cheating-daddy
items.title_zh: sohzm/cheating-daddy：号称提供“不公平优势”的开源应用
items.summary: Cheating Daddy is a free, open-source JavaScript application that its author describes as giving users an unfair advantage.

items.title: hyvor/relay
items.title_zh: hyvor/relay：面向开发者的开源邮件 API
items.summary: Relay provides an open-source email API aimed at developers, with cloud and self-hosted options positioned as alternatives to SES, Mailgun and SendGrid.

items.title: zhaochen0110/Awesome_Think_With_Images
items.title_zh: zhaochen0110/Awesome_Think_With_Images：LVLM 视觉推理资源汇总
items.summary: A resource and paper list accompanying a survey on how large vision-language models can leverage visual information for complex reasoning, planning and generation.

items.title: 11cafe/jaaz
items.title_zh: Jaaz：可本地运行的开源多模态创意助手
items.summary: Jaaz is an open-source, locally usable multimodal creative assistant positioned as a privacy-focused alternative to Canva and Manus, written in TypeScript.

items.title: weiruihhh/cs336_note_and_hw
items.title_zh: CS336 课程笔记与作业
items.summary: A Python repository that collects the author's notes and homework from studying the CS336 course.

items.title: omacom/omarchy
items.title_zh: Omarchy：美观、现代且有主见的 Linux
items.summary: Omarchy is a Shell-based project that describes itself as a beautiful, modern and opinionated Linux setup.

items.title: MedHELM: Holistic Evaluation of Large Language Models for Medical Tasks
items.title_zh: MedHELM：面向医疗任务的大语言模型整体评估
items.summary: MedHELM is an open evaluation framework for medical LLM tasks built on a clinician-validated taxonomy of 121 tasks and 35 benchmarks. Testing nine frontier models found strong results on note generation but weaker performance on clinical decision support, with DeepSeek R1 and o3-mini leading win rates while Claude 3.5 Sonnet was comparable at an estimated 40% lower compute cost.

items.title: An evaluation of LLMs for generating movie reviews: GPT-4o, Gemini-2.0 and DeepSeek-V3
items.title_zh: 大语言模型生成影评能力评估：GPT-4o、Gemini-2.0 与 DeepSeek-V3
items.summary: A framework generated movie reviews from subtitles and screenplays using GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3 and Gemini-2.0; survey participants found the reviews hard to distinguish from IMDb ones, with DeepSeek-V3 the most balanced, GPT-4o overemphasizing positive emotion and Gemini-2.0 showing excessive emotional intensity.

items.title: Evaluation of LLMs for mathematical problem solving
items.title_zh: 大语言模型数学问题求解能力评估
items.summary: Researchers compared GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3 and Gemini-2.0 on GSM8K, MATH500 and MIT OpenCourseWare math sets; GPT-4o was the most consistent, DeepSeek-V3 was strong on structured optimization but fluctuated on statistical inference, and Gemini-2.0 struggled with multi-step reasoning and symbolic logic.

items.title: Beyond Markovian: Reflective Exploration via Bayes-Adaptive RL for LLM Reasoning
items.title_zh: 超越马尔可夫：用贝叶斯自适应强化学习实现 LLM 推理的反思性探索
items.summary: The authors recast reflective exploration for LLM reasoning in a Bayesian RL framework and introduce BARL, which instructs a model to stitch and switch strategies based on observed outcomes. Experiments on synthetic and mathematical reasoning tasks show better test-time performance and token efficiency than conventional RL.

items.title: ATI: Any Trajectory Instruction for Controllable Video Generation
items.title_zh: ATI：面向可控视频生成的任意轨迹指令
items.summary: ATI is a unified framework for motion control in video generation that injects user-defined trajectories into the latent space of pretrained image-to-video models through a lightweight module. It supports camera movement, object translation and fine-grained local motion, and reports better controllability and visual quality than prior and commercial methods.

items.title: SIM: A mapping framework for built environment auditing based on street view imagery
items.title_zh: SIM：基于街景影像的建筑环境审计制图框架
items.summary: The authors introduce SIM, an open-source street view mapping framework with pipelines for measuring road width, localizing objects of known dimension in 3D and measuring street tree diameters. Three case studies demonstrate its use for built environment auditing.

items.title: DefenderBench: A Toolkit for Evaluating Language Agents in Cybersecurity Environments
items.title_zh: DefenderBench：网络安全语言智能体评测工具包
items.summary: DefenderBench is a practical open-source toolkit for evaluating language agents on network intrusion, malicious-content detection, code vulnerability analysis and cybersecurity knowledge. In the authors' benchmark Claude-3.7-sonnet scored highest at 81.65, while the best open-weight model, Llama 3.3 70B, reached 71.81.

items.title: Test Automation for Interactive Scenarios via Promptable Traffic Simulation
items.title_zh: 借助可提示交通仿真实现交互场景的自动化测试
items.summary: The paper presents an automated method that parameterizes human behavior with low-dimensional goal positions and uses a promptable traffic simulator, ProSim, plus Bayesian optimization, to generate realistic safety-critical scenarios for evaluating autonomous-vehicle planners.
